events.name: Baklava Express
events.info: Price displayed includes the admission + service fees. NOTE -- All seating is community seating, so you may be sat with other guests if they purchase tickets at your table. NOTE -- Tickets are taken off sale on the day of the event, but admission may still be purchased at the door. Baklava Express is a NYC based Cross-Cultural fusion project, led by award winning composer and oud player, Josh Kaye. The band performs original music, influenced by various traditions, from Mizrahi and Sephardi folk music, to the broader musical traditions of the Mediterranean. The eclectic influences and vast differences in the musical backgrounds of its members have created a group whose style is distinct, yet genre defiant. The band has been featured at several festivals including the Brooklyn International Music Festival, the Greek Jewish Festival, the Nyack Jazz Festival, and their music can be heard on the soundtrack of the short, animated film , "rdquo" -> Ariel" by Conor Mcfinn. Baklava Express' debut album, , "rdquo" -> Dávka" was released in 2023, and their upcoming album, , "rdquo" -> Sababa" is on track to drop in early 2026. Doors @ 6:00pm | $25 ADV / $30 DOS Show @ 7:00-9:30pm

NOTE Tickets are taken off sale on the day of the event, but admission may still be purchased at the door.The Smiths etc, a tribute to The Smiths, return on Black Saturday to Lovin Cup for another lively and engaging celebration of the greatest and most influential alternative/post-punk band of the 80s.Celebrating the 40th anniversary of The Queen Is Dead, the show will feature There Is a Light That Never Goes Out, Bigmouth Strikes Again and other tracks from that landmark album, along with Smiths anthems such as How Soon Is Now?, Heaven Knows Im Miserable Now and This Charming Man.Doors @ 7:00pm | $20 ADV / $25 DOSShow @ 8:00-10:30pm

events.name: Bill Kirchen’s Honky Tonk Holiday Show: presented by Bop Shop Records
events.info: Price displayed includes the admission + service fees. NOTE All seating is community seating, so you may be sat with other guests if they purchase tickets at your table. NOTE Tickets are taken off sale on the day of the event, but admission may still be purchased at the door.Bill Kirchen is making a stop on his annual Honky Tonk Holiday Tour at Lovin Cup on Sunday 11/29! Featured is a sleigh-full of rarely heard holiday numbers from the blues, rock n roll and honky tonk bags: Silent Surfin Night, Truckin Trees for Christmas, Santa Claus Wants Some Lovin, and more. But be ye not afraid, therell be so much more than holiday songs of questionable taste; you can count on a truckload of dieselbilly classics, rockers, and country weepers to take the edge off the holiday fuss. So mark your calendars and check em twice - Santa Claus is back in town! Kirchen is touring with his all-star Texas guys - Jack Saunders on bass and Rick Richards on drums.Grammy nominated guitarist, singer and songwriter Bill Kirchen first gained national recognition as a founding father of Commander Cody and his Lost Planet Airmen. His trademark guitar licks drove their Hot Rod Lincoln cut into the Top Ten in 1972.He has released over a dozen albums under his own name, and played guitar live or on record with a whos who of Americana and Roots RockN Roll, among them Gene Vincent, Link Wray, Bo Diddley, Hazel Dickens, Doug Sahm, Hoyt Axton, Emmylou Harris, Maria Muldaur, Dan Hicks, Nick Lowe and Elvis Costello.His latest recording Cat out of the Bag released May 22, 2026 on Last Music Company.Doors @ 6:00pm | $30 ADV / $35 DOSShow @ 7:00-9:30pm

events.name: AN IRISH CHRISTMAS with John Doyle, Cathie Ryan, and Mick McAuley
events.info: Price displayed includes the admission + service fees. NOTE All seating is community seating, so you may be sat with other guests if they purchase tickets at your table. NOTE Tickets are taken off sale on the day of the event, but admission may still be purchased at the door.This festive celebration brings three of Irish musics most beloved performers to the stage in a program woven through with song and story - from cherished carols and traditional tunes and airs to newly composed songs for the season.Mick McAuley, renowned melodeon player and longtime collaborator of John Doyle, co-wrote and recorded This Christmas Time, a holiday album the two released in 2024. That recording is the heart and soul of An Irish Christmas, and Mick is delighted to be bringing it to American audiences alongside two of his favorite musical partners.Cathie Ryan is a natural fit for this holiday tour, having carved out a reputation for her own beloved Christmas performances over the years. A highly regarded singer, songwriter, performer, and educator, Cathie is a towering presence in traditional music circles on both sides of the Atlantic. Both Cathie and John are members of The Irish Music Masters and are featured on the PBS television special The Soul of Christmas.All three have toured together before, and their chemistry on stage is undeniable. John, Cathie, and Mick are looking forward to bringing An Irish Christmas to audiences across the United States - a warm and joyful evening of music and story in the finest Irish tradition.Doors @ 7pm | $30 seated/standing/doorsShow @ 8-10pm

events.name: Be Like Blippi Tour - Photo Experience
events.info: Meet Blippi ON STAGE and have the opportunity to take your photo with Blippi in this one-of-a-kind Photo Experience! You'll also receive a souvenir tour lanyard with a Be Like Blippi Tour Pass to commemorate the day. Don't miss your chance to create unforgettable, treasured memories with your children that will last a lifetime! Here's how it works: Photo Experience ticket purchasers should go to the Will Call window at the Box Office on the show day to pick up their passes and after-show instructions. Each adult and child (age two and up) in a group must have a Photo Experience ticket in order to attend. The Photo Experience will start shortly after the end of show. Please make sure to bring your camera, as you will want to capture every moment!
events.pleaseNote: Parents, please note that while most children are excited to meet their favorite characters up-close, others can feel frightened. If your child is scared or hesitant to meet Blippi, we recommend moving to the back of the line; This will allow your child the extra time they may need to warm up to Blippi and see how they interact with other children present. **Admission to the performance is not included in the Photo Experience ticket. This is a separate upgrade that must be purchased in advance. **Children aged 12 and under must be accompanied by a Parent/Guardian. Each Child, Parent or Guardian must have a show ticket as well as a Photo Experience ticket to attend.
